newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese yuan ends up at intraday high vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Chinese yuan ends up at intraday high vs dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at an intraday high of 8.2914 on Monday from last Friday's 8.2924 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai due to buying below the 8.2920 level, traders said.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2921.

The yuan opened higher at 8.2920 and hit an intraday low of 8.2921 early in the session. It then rose slightly to move in a range of 8.2915 and 8.2918 for most of the session before closing at the high. Trading was dull with most business done at 8.2917, traders said.
One dealer said buying below the 8.2920 level, seen as the short-term resistance point, supported the local currency.
"When the yuan breached the resistance level in early trading, follow-up buying kept the yuan at high levels," he said.
But a second dealer said Monday's rise was weak because it was not accompanied by heavy volume.
"The fact that the central bank intervened late last week to depress the yuan made traders cautious, resulting in slow trading," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to fall slightly on Tuesday on a technical correction.
The yuan closed slightly down at 7.1202 from 7.1100 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0702 from 1.0711 against the Hong Kong dollar.
